pages.title: Generated Mappings
pages.text: $(thing)config/auram/rock_recipes.json$() maps rock IDs to output IDs and counts. Auram samples source loot with rock replacement temporarily bypassed, then saves the mappings.$(br2)This is generated data, not a permanent balancing override: startup or a data reload can replace manual edits.

pages.title: Missing Recipes
pages.text: First try $(thing)/reload$() or restart so the built-in generated pack can use the calculated mappings.$(br2)If a rock still has no conversion, inspect the server log and the mapping for that rock. Ores with no usable sampled drop cannot produce a conversion. JEI shows the recipes currently loaded by the server.
